vid_urls.title: NASA Moon Base: November 2026 Update (Nov. 7, 2026)
vid_urls.description:
Join us live from the MAX POWER aerospace expo as we provide an update on our upcoming Moon Base near the lunar South Pole.

Participants in this news conference, taking place at NASA's Kennedy Space Center, include:

- NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman
- Carlos García-Galán, manager, Moon Base Program
- Nicky Fox, associate administrator for Science, NASA Headquarters
- Dayna Ise, acting director, Utility and Infrastructure Office, Moon Base Program

Learn more about this weekend's MAX POWER events: https://go.nasa.gov/4knRFWI
Learn more about Moon Base: https://www.nasa.gov/moonbase/

vid_urls.title: U.S. Spacewalk 101
vid_urls.description:
On Thursday, Nov. 5, NASA astronaut Anil Menon and CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk will install and deploy the eighth and final International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Array (IROSA), completing the space station's power system augmentation. Together, the eight roll-out arrays will increase the station's available power by up to 30%. 

The spacewalk is scheduled to begin at 8:30 a.m. EST (1330 UTC) and will last around six and a half hours.

Learn more about this spacewalk: https://go.nasa.gov/4yRBm97
Get daily updates from the space station: https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/

description:
NASA astronaut Anil Menon and CSA astronaut Joshua Kutryk will install and deploy the eighth and final IROSA on the 3B channel of the space station, completing the power augmentation upgrades.

The final two roll-out solar arrays will complete the space station’s power system augmentation. Together, the eight roll-out arrays will increase available power by up to 30%, boosting the station’s electric power generation capacity from 160 kilowatts to approximately 215 kilowatts.
